_comment: Pinned third-party binaries. fetch_binaries.py downloads ONLY from these URLs and
FAILS HARD on any checksum mismatch — it never warns and continues.
Two hashes are recorded per component and they mean different things:
as_supplied_sha256 : the archive an operator placed on this machine. Proves what
was inspected. Proves nothing about authenticity.
published_sha256   : taken from the publisher's own checksum file. THIS is the one
that establishes authenticity, and fetch_binaries.py verifies
against it.
Sources are constrained by docs/licensing/LICENSING-GATE-V1.md:
ffprobe   : BtbN FFmpeg-Builds win64-lgpl-shared ONLY.
gyan.dev main builds are GPLv3 and MUST NOT be used.
MediaInfo : mediaarea.net or the official MediaArea GitHub release ONLY.
Never the GUI. Never a libcurl-enabled build. Never <= 0.7.62.
AMENDED 2026-08-09 (SPEC LOCK): FFmpeg may be LGPL v2.1 OR v3. --enable-version3 is
permitted; gmp, libaribb24, liblensfun and libzvbi are no longer prohibited.
--enable-gpl and --enable-nonfree remain absolutely prohibited.
PINNING RULE (2026-08-09): download_url MUST point at an immutable, version-named
release asset. BtbN's `latest` tag is rolling — the same filename is replaced on every
rebuild, so pinning to it makes the build unreproducible tomorrow. The dated
autobuild-* release is immutable and is what we pin.

components.name: ffprobe
status_reason: Windows x64, shared build, no --enable-gpl, no --enable-nonfree, and every
library in FFmpeg's EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_GPL_LIST / NONFREE / GPLV3 lists is
explicitly disabled. Verified by running the installed binary.
The build carries --enable-version3 and is therefore LGPL v3, not v2.1. That is
PERMITTED since the 2026-08-09 SPEC LOCK amendment (LICENSING-GATE-V1.md 2.0).
The upstream build recipe confirms it independently: FFmpeg-Builds
variants/defaults-lgpl.sh reads FF_CONFIGURE="--enable-version3 --disable-debug"
and sets LICENSE_FILE="COPYING.LGPLv3", while --enable-gpl appears only in
defaults-gpl.sh and --enable-nonfree only in the *-nonfree variants.
AUTHENTICITY (G-10, resolved 2026-08-09): BtbN publishes checksums.sha256 with
every release. Both the rolling `latest` asset and the immutable dated asset were
verified against it, and the eight installed files were confirmed byte-identical
between the two archives.
as_supplied_note: The operator supplied the rolling `latest` repack. Its hash matches BtbN's own
published checksum, so it is authentic — but the `latest` asset is overwritten on
every rebuild and must never be the pinned download source. The immutable asset
below contains byte-identical binaries and is what fetch_binaries.py uses.
components.published_sha256_verified: 2026-08-09 — downloaded and hashed; matches the published line exactly
components.required_license: LGPL-2.1-or-later or LGPL-3.0-or-later (version must be detected and named in notices)

_comment: LGPL corresponding source for the EXACT shipped binary (gate G-5).
The binary's version string n8.1.2-34-g9b6c8969e0 is a git describe: release tag
n8.1.2, 34 commits ahead, at commit 9b6c8969e0. All three parts were confirmed
against FFmpeg's own repository, and the archive's seven library version headers
match the seven versions the binary prints. packaging/verify_source.py re-runs
every one of those checks.
The archive is NOT committed to Git (13 MB of upstream source). It is
reproducible byte-for-byte from the commit below by
tools/fetch_corresponding_source.py, because git archive is deterministic.
corresponding_source.hosting_status: NOT LIVE - the archive is built, verified and reproducible, and the location is now the intended one, but itisyou.app/products/preflightqc/source does not yet serve it. A human must publish both archives there and commit to a three-year offer before any distribution. See docs/licensing/CORRESPONDING-SOURCE-PLAN.md actions H-1 to H-4.

_comment: Gate G-6: the exact build recipe that produced the shipped binary.
BtbN's releases do not name the FFmpeg-Builds commit they were built from, so it
was identified from the public CI run that produced this release:
workflow 'Build FFmpeg' run #3054, started 2026-08-09T12:09:09Z, concluded
success at 13:28:11Z; the release was published at 13:04:44Z.
This is a CI-run attribution, not a publisher declaration. It is corroborated by
the recipe producing exactly the shipped configure line's licence-relevant flags.
build_recipe_source.hosting_status: NOT LIVE - same release-domain prerequisite as corresponding_source.

components.name: mediainfo
components.role: complementary inspector (scan type, frame-rate mode, fast start, HDR naming)
status_reason: MediaInfo 26.05 CLI, Windows x64. BSD-2-Clause era (>= 0.7.63), not the GUI.
The archive ships LIBCURL.DLL but MediaInfo.exe does not statically import it
(imports are KERNEL32 and SHELL32 only), so the network feature is optional and
LIBCURL.DLL was deliberately NOT installed — the licensing gate forbids shipping
it. Verified running from third-party/bin/.
AUTHENTICITY (G-10, resolved 2026-08-09): MediaArea publishes NO checksum file for
the Windows CLI zip — .sha256, .sha512, SHA256SUMS and checksums.txt all 404, and
the MediaArea/MediaInfo GitHub release carries no assets. The strongest available
verification was therefore performed instead: the archive was re-downloaded from
MediaArea's own HTTPS origin and is byte-identical to the supplied one, and the
extracted MediaInfo.exe is byte-identical to the installed one. This is
origin-authenticated, not digest-authenticated; see published_sha256 below.
components.origin_verified_method: 2026-08-09 — re-downloaded over TLS from mediaarea.net and hashed; byte-identical to the supplied archive
components.build_identifier: MediaInfo Command line / MediaInfoLib v26.05, Windows x64
components.source_note: MediaInfo is BSD-2-Clause, which carries no source-provision obligation. The repository is recorded for attribution and diligence, not because a gate requires it.
excluded_files: LIBCURL.DLL — network feature, forbidden by the licensing gate
Plugin/, Contrib/, History.txt, ReadMe.txt — not runtime files
components.minimum_version_reason: 0.7.62 and earlier are GPL (CLI) / LGPL (library) and impose copyleft
